summary: Phase 2 Webstores ribbon consolidation — all 9 frontend tests PASSED. WebstoresRibbon renders inside the fixed <header> with all 10 group captions (Dashboard, Create / Setup, Manage Stores, Products, Orders, Questionnaires, Owner Portal, Payments / Payouts, Analytics, Tools / Settings) and all 10 data-testid buttons. Old ActionToolbar and create-store-btn are correctly removed on /webstores. Section header (data-testid='webstores-section-header' / '-section-title') drives the visible heading. Legacy tab-stores/tab-orders remain in DOM as sr-only for automation. Tab switching, Create dialog (with ?new=true strip), gear -> store-detail-dialog with inner tabs (Dashboard/Products/Settings & Branding + Analytics/Orders/Payouts), Products route, and all out-of-module ribbon routes (/questionnaires, /admin/payments, /reports/profit-margin, /settings) navigate without 404. Ribbon stays accessible at 1366x800 via overflow-x-auto.

tests_executed.TEST 1 ribbon visibility: PASS — webstores-ribbon present inside <header>, all 10 group captions match exactly, all 10 ribbon button testids resolve.
tests_executed.TEST 2 single command surface: PASS — data-testid='action-toolbar' NOT rendered on /webstores; data-testid='create-store-btn' NOT rendered; webstores-section-header shows 'All Stores'; legacy tab-stores/tab-orders still queryable (sr-only TabsList). NOTE: Playwright is_visible() returns true for sr-only because clip-based hiding is treated as visible by Playwright — not a real visual regression; visually the strip is hidden under section header.
tests_executed.TEST 3 store list & actions: PASS — 15 store rows render; gear click (via page.evaluate) opens store-detail-dialog.
tests_executed.TEST 4 products route: PASS — ribbon-products navigates to /products and renders without crash/404.
tests_executed.TEST 5 new store via ribbon: PASS — ribbon-create opens 'Create New Webstore' dialog with 'Store Type *' label and 'Store Name *' input; URL restored to /webstores (no ?new=true) after close.
tests_executed.TEST 6 tab switching: PASS — ribbon-orders flips section title to 'Webstore Orders'; ribbon-stores flips back to 'All Stores'. ?tab= query is stripped post-mount as designed.
tests_executed.TEST 7 inner tabs in dialog: PASS — Detail dialog inner tabs render: Dashboard, Products, Settings & Branding, Analytics, Orders (2), Payouts.
tests_executed.TEST 8 other ribbon routes: PASS — Questionnaires (/questionnaires), Payments (/admin/payments), Analytics (/reports/profit-margin), Tools (/settings) all navigate; no 404 in-app page. Owner Portal opens in new tab (not navigated in same window per design).
tests_executed.TEST 9 medium viewport 1366px: PASS — Ribbon has overflow-x-auto, scrollWidth==clientWidth==1366; all 10 buttons remain in DOM and visible at viewport edges.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 — caught by frontend AxiosError 'Error loading products' on /webstores and /products. Pre-existing, not introduced by Phase 2 ribbon work, but affects Products page rendering.

integration_issues.issue: Page mounts but React error boundary catches an internal error: 'An error occurred in the <Questionnaires> component'. Page does not 404 in-app but the component itself errors out. Pre-existing — unrelated to ribbon, but ribbon now exposes this route as a primary entry point so it is more visible.
Uncaught ReferenceError: fetchCustomers is not defined — fires on dashboard load. Pre-existing; not related to Phase 2.

issues: Minor: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning) on Create New Webstore dialog — pre-existing, not Phase 2 specific.

action_items: Investigate /api/products HTTP 500 (pre-existing, but high visibility now ribbon links Products).
Fix Questionnaires component runtime error caught by error boundary (pre-existing).
Optional: tighten the sr-only TabsList so Playwright is_visible() returns false (use display:none on the wrapper but keep testids; otherwise this is a cosmetic concern only).
critical_code_review_comments: WebstoresRibbon.js cleanly separates query-param signalling from page state — good. Active state for ribbon-dashboard and ribbon-stores both light up when tab='stores'; consider differentiating Dashboard (overview) from Stores list semantically in a future phase.
MainLayout HEADER_HEIGHT toggles 152↔168 based on activeTab — uses window.innerWidth in style on initial render which can hydrate-mismatch on SSR, but app is CSR only so OK.
Webstores.js is 3222 lines — exceeds 700 LOC guideline. Recommend splitting (orders pane, dialog, settings pane, products pane) in a future refactor. Not blocking for Phase 2.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 15 webstores in production signguy_ai DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 ribbon is stable and integrates with Webstores.js query-param sync correctly. The /api/products 500 and Questionnaires component error are pre-existing and orthogonal to the ribbon. If retesting Phase 2, the only edge case to recheck is whether sr-only TabsList tab-stores/tab-orders selectors keep working for legacy automation — they do (queryable but visually hidden).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no Phase 2 regressions found. Pre-existing /api/products 500 and Questionnaires render error are unrelated to navigation consolidation.
